     - 5× NBA MVP, 6× NBA Finals MVP, 10× Scoring Champion, 14× All-Star, 3× All-Star MVP.
     - 2× Olympic Gold Medalist (1984, 1992).

   - **Legacy:** 
     - Global cultural icon, founder of the Air Jordan brand with Nike, and a key figure in expanding the NBA's international reach.
     - Inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame in 2009.
